activationEnabled.description: If activation is supported, is recording activation in this remote KB enabled. Not currently used

activationSupported.description: Does this remote KB support content activation. Not currently used

active.description: If harvesting is supported, is harvesting from this remote KB activated

credentials.description: Credentials used to authenticate with the remote KB. Not currently used

cursor.description: Marks progress through a harvest. May be a timestamp, a transaction id, or another service-specific value depending on `type`

principal.description: Identity/username used to authenticate with the remote KB. Not currently used

readonly.description: Marks the KB as protected/read-only, Used to prevent deletion the "LOCAL" source representing the local KB.

rectype.description: The kind of record this KB primarily deals in

supportsHarvesting.description: Does this remote KB support harvesting

trustedSourceTI.description: Marks the KB as a trusted source of title instance metadata

type.description: Name of the Spring bean that implements this KB's adapter
